seoTitle: How to Sync Google Workspace with Microsoft Outlook 365
metaDescription: Learn how to connect your Google Workspace Gmail account to Microsoft Outlook 365, including IMAP setup and app password configuration.
intro: If you prefer Outlook's interface but need to manage a Google Workspace email account, syncing the two lets you handle everything from one app. This guide covers enabling IMAP and configuring Outlook to connect with your Workspace Gmail.

steps.heading: Enable IMAP in Google Workspace
steps.body: In your Gmail settings, turn on IMAP access so external email clients like Outlook can connect to your account.

steps.heading: Generate an app password if needed
steps.body: If two-step verification is enabled, you may need to create an app-specific password to use in place of your regular login.

steps.heading: Add your account in Outlook
steps.body: Open Outlook 365 and add a new account, entering your Workspace Gmail address and the correct credentials or app password.

steps.heading: Configure server settings
steps.body: Enter the correct incoming and outgoing server details for Gmail's IMAP and SMTP servers if Outlook doesn't detect them automatically.

steps.heading: Confirm mail, contacts, and calendar sync
steps.body: Once connected, check that your emails, contacts, and calendar events from Workspace appear correctly inside Outlook.

faq.question: Do I need an app password to connect Gmail to Outlook?
faq.answer: If your account uses two-step verification, yes — an app-specific password is typically required instead of your normal login password.

faq.question: Will syncing to Outlook affect my Gmail account directly?
faq.answer: No, syncing simply lets Outlook access your existing Gmail data through IMAP — it doesn't change anything on the Workspace side.

faq.question: Can I sync my Google Calendar to Outlook as well?
faq.answer: Yes, in addition to email, you can typically sync your Google Calendar events into Outlook for a unified schedule view.

faq.question: Is this method secure compared to using third-party sync tools?
faq.answer: Using IMAP directly with an app password is generally more secure than relying on third-party sync tools, since it keeps the connection between Google and Microsoft only.
